manufacturer_status: Schneppa Glass (brand listed by Lyndons; exact manufacturer not independently verified)
description_as_listed:
Glow in the dark stones are really something special. Schneppa PolyGlow™ stones are a high quality photoluminescent aggregate designed for use in polished concrete, exposed aggregate concrete and loose mulch applications. You’ll find it hard to go past these bright reactive stones.
Unlike many photoluminescent products currently available, Schneppa Glass, offers premium-grade PolyGlow™ Stones with strontium aluminate—the active compound responsible for absorbing and emitting light—embedded throughout the entire aggregate in a highly concentrated form. This is particularly important for applications such as polished and exposed aggregate concrete. Products where the glow compound is only applied as a surface coating can lose effectiveness over time. As the aggregate is ground, polished, or subjected to wear, the coating can be removed, significantly reducing its ability to glow. By contrast, PolyGlow™ Stones maintain consistent performance, as the active compound is present throughout the entire stone, ensuring long-lasting luminosity even as the surface wears.
PolyGlow™ Glow stones are -
* 5-15mm size grading
* Tumbled so no sharp edges
* Made from premium grade photoluminescent aggregate (Strontium aluminate)

ProDrain® Cuspated Sheet Drains are cost effective dimpled plastic sheet that provides effective drainage and protects the waterproofing membrane. This sheet also acts as a thermal insulation barrier adjacent to the waterproofing, making the product ideal for use in landscaping applications, basement walls, tunnel linings, landfills and road drainage.
The integrated non-woven geotextile covering attached to the polymer core prevents soil particles from migrating into the core and blocking the drainage sheet. Wide and easy to handle roll size makes the product quick and low cost installation.
All products have common features of unique polymer void geometry combined with a nonwoven geotextile attached to one side of the product. The core profile allows for the efficient discharge of water along the core with the geotextile preventing any blockage of the core from fine soil particle movement.
Application: The ProDrain® Sheet Drain System is used to replace conventional drainage aggregate systems, saving time and money due to its lightweight structure and quick and easy installation without the need for heavy equipment. Cutting of the roll, on site, is easy to carry out, to suit the application specifics.
Common applications include
Plaza Decks, Roof Decks and Planters
Retaining Walls
Foundations and Basement Drains
Benefits of ProDrain® Cuspated Sheet Drains
Solve drainage issues from the backfilled side of retaining walls etc
Allows for high-volume flow paths for liquids
Lightweight and easy to handle
Quick and easy to install
Cost-effective replacement for primary natural resources.

description_as_listed:
Ciment Fondu is a rapid hardening cement that sets in a similar time to Portland and allows concrete to be put into service after 6 and 24 hours. Particularly suited to areas subject to abrasion and wear, such as industrial floors, flume linings and spillways, and also resistant to chemicals and extreme temperatures. Used as a Portland cement accelerator in non-structural applications, including render, screeds and grouting materials.
Ciment Fondu – High-Performance Hydraulic Binder for Refractory and Construction Applications Ciment Fondu is a hydraulic binder with approximately 40% alumina content, primarily composed of calcium aluminate phases. It is ideally suited for refractory and construction chemistry applications, offering exceptional mechanical strength and durability. The primary mineralogical phase, calcium aluminate (CaAl2O4), contributes to the material’s excellent mechanical properties, making it a highly effective binder for mortars and concretes. Due to its 16% iron oxide content, Ciment Fondu is well-suited for refractory applications in non-reducing atmospheres, where iron oxide can be tolerated. It is also recommended for use in applications requiring rapid hardening, resistance to abrasion, mechanical shock, and intermediate temperature exposure.
Key Features:
High Alumina Content – Approximately 40% alumina, ensuring superior mechanical strength and durability.
Calcium Aluminate Composition – Imparts excellent mechanical properties to mortars and concretes.
Refractory Applications – Suitable for high-temperature applications in non-reducing atmospheres.
Rapid Hardening & High Performance – Ideal for products requiring rapid setting, resistance to abrasion, and exposure to intermediate temperatures.
Versatile Use – Suitable for various applications in construction chemistry and refractory industries. Choose Ciment Fondu for superior performance in high-temperature, rapid-hardening, and high-performance cement applications. Ideal for environments that demand exceptional durability and mechanical strength.

description_as_listed:
The Cement Australia Oxides range gives you unlimited possibilities to improve the aesthetics of concrete, mortars and renders through coloured finishes. Australian Cement oxides are a high quality rich colour additive available in 1kg packs or large 20kg pails. These UV resistant powders will provide long lasting colour to a wide range of projects.
Oxide allows for the contractor to control the dose and therefore the depth of colour. The black oxide lightens slightly over the first 5 days as the cement cures. Ensure your ratio percentage is based on the cement content only, as oxide will not colour sand or stone. For best results, follow the instructions on the Oxide pack carefully. Always accurately measure all ingredients, including water; and for multiple mixes, always use the same quantities. For lighter, deeper colours use either White or Off White Cement or Render. Black, brown and red work best in Grey Cement. Sand can also affect colour, so source enough sand in one purchase to complete your project.
The maximum colour saturation you can achieve is 10% oxide addition of the cement content. Therefore you can avoid wastage and weakening of your mix by not overdosing on oxide.
Features:
Reliable and predictable colouring
Beautiful, long-lasting coloured finishes
Less cost and less hassle for upkeep of coloured mortars, renders, and concrete
Suitable for DIY through to commercial projects

description_as_listed:
Available in a range of 30 colours, designs and textures, CCS Stylepave Overlay Concrete Resurfacing System is a cost-effective solution to dramatically enhance and renovate any concrete surface.
